description: [stores] Persist a value across your instances: PUT /memory/{ns}/{key}. Required: namespace + key + value. Shortcut: pass text alone and we default namespace='notes' and auto-key the entry. Optionally set ttl (seconds, min 60, max 30 days) for auto-eviction.

key.description: entry name; auto-generated when using text shortcut

namespace.description: logical grouping (e.g. 'projects'); default 'notes' when using text shortcut

text.description: shortcut: store this string as value under notes/<auto-key>

name: store_memory
